feed.exporter: the build (the repository's tables, no live feed: a recording rule would compose the layers' ratios)

wire.cpp_none: none: a composition of measured tables by the product law, read as tools/whole_system.py writes it
wire.moves: work flows down both columns; the reading cursor walks the pieces, one a decision

monitors.name: The seven organisms, three loads
monitors.what: Each organism's misses against native under its own load, the climb and the line (the realms table).

feed.exporter: the build (the repository's tables, no live feed: a recording rule would compose the layers' ratios)

wire.moves: the reading cursor walks every organism under every load, one a decision

monitors.name: Every muscle of the catalog
monitors.what: The 1,107 muscles as one matrix, each cell its word against native, by family and realm; a click names the muscle.

feed.exporter: the build (the repository's tables, no live feed: a recording rule would compose the layers' ratios)

wire.moves: the reading cursor walks the 1,107 muscles, one a decision; a click holds one

monitors.name: The scale-out grid
monitors.what: Seven organisms × copies × runs: every square's word, modelled and with the real cluster inside.

feed.exporter: the build (the repository's tables, no live feed: a recording rule would compose the layers' ratios)

wire.cpp_none: none: the grid's squares as its runs on GitHub write them
wire.moves: the reading cursor walks every square with runs started, one a decision; the age of GitHub's reading counts up every second

monitors.name: GitHub Actions: the runs in flight
monitors.what: Every workflow run in progress or queued when the page was built, the Azure set's repetitions done of its cap, and the clouds' gates.
monitors.cls: L (GitHub's own API, read at the build)

feed.exporter: GitHub Actions API (read at the build); live: github-actions-exporter

wire.cpp_none: none: GitHub's own record of its runs, read from its API at the build
wire.moves: the reading cursor walks the workflows, one a decision; the age of GitHub's reading counts up every second

monitors.name: The master switch and the kill switch
monitors.what: The switch above the brain: ON, Omni-Compass governs every wired muscle; engaged, every setting is handed back to native's own controller at once and every Omni-Compass side on the page follows native.
monitors.cls: S (the page's port of the master switch; the real one is omnicompass/master.py)

feed.exporter: tools/omni_exporter.py (the governor's own audit, Prometheus text format)

wire.moves: every decision: the brain's pulse and the work flowing down to every muscle; the switch acts at once

monitors.name: Self-governed rendering
monitors.what: This page's own render loop governed by the compass law: the frame time against its line, native (no governor) beside Omni-Compass.

feed.exporter: this page's own clock (no exporter: the page measures itself)

wire.moves: every frame: this page's own frame time under the compass law
